estimator.rationale: Characters/4 is the standard rough BPE estimate for English prose and source code. It is an ESTIMATE, not a tokenizer measurement: error is typically ±20%, worse for CJK, base64, minified JSON or long identifiers. Only deltas measured with the SAME estimator are meaningful; do not compare against counts from a different tokenizer.
limits: Timing strings inside tool text (e.g. 'in 2.63ms') are dynamic; run-to-run variation is <15 chars.
The zero-hit path-search text may gain a dynamic diagnostic hint at runtime (not captured here).
Formatter tokenCount itself uses ceil(chars/4); it is not an independent measurement.
